polymer.basis: Classification and typical values from polymer handbooks and resin data sheets, as compiled for the estimate model (docs/audits/2026-09-15-filtering-estimates-data/physics/). The document cited prints a density inside the range, not its ends. Mitsubishi Chemical Advanced Materials' sheet for Proteus HDPE (R-MCAM-PROTEUS-HDPE-DS), a high-density polyethylene, prints a specific gravity of 0.96 (ASTM D792; its ISO density cell is empty) and a water absorption in water at 23 °C below 0.01 % after 24 h and below 0.01 % at saturation (ISO 62 and ASTM D570), p. 1. The Cambridge Materials Data Book (R-CUED-MATERIALS-DATA-BOOK-2003, SHA-256 2bcf739fd66f...) gives polyethylene 0.939-0.96 Mg/m³. Neither prints a figure below 0.939, where the range begins at 0.900.
